name: Arizona State University
summary: Public university with campuses in the Phoenix area, including Tempe: 15,000+ international students and engineering in 25+ disciplines.

ib.text: No IB points minimum is published. ASU asks for a 3.00 (B) grade average from secondary school and a diploma, plus English proficiency; its page has an IB Diploma credential guide.

programmes.name: Electrical Engineering
programmes.about: A 120-credit Fulton Schools of Engineering degree on circuits, signals, control, electromagnetics, power and quantum engineering, with hands-on problem-solving as Arizona's semiconductor industry grows.
programmes.selectionNote: First-year admission needs a 1210 SAT or 24 ACT, or a 3.00 GPA in ASU competency courses, or top 25% of your class, with no maths or science gaps.

flagshipSource.title: ASU engineering and technology degrees: #1 in the US for electrical engineering bachelor's degrees

notes: The Fall 2027 deadline is not published yet; the Fall 2026 page gave a priority deadline of 15 January and admission is reviewed as applications arrive, so apply early.
For 2026-27 an international undergraduate pays base tuition of $39,062 plus fees; ASU puts the total with housing, books, insurance and travel at $69,906.
International students do not qualify for federal or state aid; ASU's merit-based New American University Scholarship goes to a limited number of high achievers.
